# PayOnce

> Verification of Payee for AI agents, on Concordium testnet only. No mainnet payments, no real money.

An agent checks that the receiving account belongs to the name on the invoice before any money moves, and pays exactly once. Outcomes: Match, Close match, No match, Not possible (EU VoP, Reg 2024/886). The agent itself pays only on Match.

Others (VeriFlow, x402-doctor) check that a payTo is the agent's registered wallet. PayOnce checks a different object: the name on the invoice.

## Live

- Site: https://payonce-tau.vercel.app
- 60-second demo (no wallet): https://payonce-tau.vercel.app/demo
- Dashboard (wallet): https://payonce-tau.vercel.app/app?dash=1
- Run-it (v2 registry): https://payonce-tau.vercel.app/app
- Census (upper bound): https://payonce-tau.vercel.app/app/proof/census
- Payee card: https://payonce-tau.vercel.app/p/{account}
- Badge: https://payonce-api-n98a.onrender.com/api/badge/{account}.svg?name={invoice name}
- API: https://payonce-api-n98a.onrender.com/api/vop/config
- Repo: https://github.com/mohamedwael201193/payonce

## Rules for claims

- Testnet names are self-asserted mock identities. "PayOnce Labs" is a labelled stand-in.
- The chain does not verify the ZK name proof. It enforces payee signature, cooling-off, version, pay-once.
- Do not say "no rival checks the receiving account". Say: we check the account belongs to the name on the invoice.
- Do not say agents are verified, safe, legitimate or fraudulent. The census is an upper bound on preconditions.
- acknowledge_payee accepts Close match; the agent pays only on Match. Not possible cannot be overridden. No match cannot be overridden.
- The 90 s hold is the demo book; a production book would be 24 h+, set at init.
- No funds are held for refund. Recourse is prevention (check, cooling-off, void_payable before pay).
